It goes by way of Scenic stretch near Clifton Springs, near Gordon and near Yea. near Rosebud is the high point.

melbourne-victoria-high-country-omeo-wee.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: This High point near Rosebud → Scenic stretch near Clifton Springs stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Scenic stretch near Clifton Springs → Photo stop near Gordon is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

This Photo stop near Gordon → Food stop near Yea stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
